assembly_instructions: Root everything on the PCB. Populate the board: a gold PCIe edge connector, the FPGA BGA package carrying the exposed silicon die, an in-package HBM stack on each side, a clock oscillator, two bulk decoupling caps and an auxiliary power tap; a brushed-steel cold plate and its finned stack cap the die. From the four die corners, four thin brushed-steel standoff risers (clear of the heatsink footprint) lift an exploded logic-floorplan plate directly above the die; the plate carries the synthesized CFNTT-KRED butterfly datapath (compact_bf_v2). Two conflict-free memory banks (white composite) with their address generators stream u/v coefficients into input DFFs, while a single shared 1023-word twiddle ROM (black composite, storing W = 9^-1·w) feeds the w delay chain. Before the multiplier two selects sit: v_mux picks the A operand (v for NTT, v−u for INTT) and the NTT/INTT mux picks the B operand (W or op21(W)). The K-RED modular multiplier is a 4-stage pipeline — ONE 14×14→28 hardware multiplier (brass), then two shift-add fold stages (d = 3z+6q−z>>12; e = 3d+q−d>>12) and one conditional subtraction — producing 9·A·B mod q. A modular_add combines u with the product; two modular_half (op21) copper gates, one on the ROM output and one on the add path, derive the per-stage INTT halving that fixes the reference's 2^10-scaling bug, with add_mux selecting the halved sum onto the bank writeback during INTT. A copper PWM return bus feeds the K-RED result back into v_mux for the double-pass mode. A control FSM sequences the banks, ROM addresses, both muxes and the sel line; a copper datapath bus threads the stages.

info.summary: An FPGA accelerator that computes the Number Theoretic Transform (NTT) — the polynomial-multiplication core of lattice-based post-quantum cryptography — using the lightweight K-RED modular-reduction scheme instead of full Montgomery/Barrett reduction.
info.description: The NTT is a finite-field analogue of the FFT that turns O(n^2) polynomial multiplication in Z_q[x]/(x^n+1) into O(n log n) butterfly passes; it is the throughput bottleneck of schemes like Kyber, NewHope and Dilithium. This design maps a bank of Cooley–Tukey/Gentleman–Sande butterfly processing elements onto the FPGA fabric, streaming coefficients from on-package HBM and reading twiddle factors from a ROM. The distinguishing feature is the K-RED (and K-RED-2x) reduction of Longa & Naehrig: by choosing a modulus q = k·2^m + 1, each partial product is reduced with a couple of shifts, a multiply-by-k and an add rather than a full division, shrinking the critical path and DSP/LUT cost of every butterfly.

facts.label: Twiddle storage
facts.value: on-chip ROM/BRAM of precomputed roots of unity

facts.label: Complexity
facts.value: O(n log n) vs O(n^2) schoolbook

sources.title: Longa & Naehrig, Speeding up the Number Theoretic Transform (K-RED)
Alkim et al., Post-quantum key exchange – NewHope

parts.name: Accelerator PCB
parts.role: The printed circuit board that carries the FPGA, memory and power components; root of the assembly.

parts.name: PCIe edge connector
parts.role: Gold-plated PCIe finger edge connector that plugs the card into a host slot and carries coefficients on/off the board.

parts.name: FPGA package
parts.role: The FPGA BGA package substrate housing the reconfigurable logic that implements the CFNTT-KRED butterfly datapath.

parts.name: Silicon die
parts.role: Exposed FPGA silicon die where the butterfly, K-RED multiplier and memory address logic are physically synthesized; the exploded overlay above is its floorplan lifted out on the four standoff risers.

parts.name: Heatsink cold plate
parts.role: Machined cold plate spreading heat off the die into the finned stack above; footprint kept inside the standoff ring so the risers clear it.

parts.name: Heatsink fin stack
parts.role: Comb of parallel extruded aluminium fins standing on the cold plate; dissipates the die's heat into board airflow (modelled as one finned mass rather than separate slabs).

parts.name: Exploded-view standoff (front-right)
parts.role: Thin riser tying the front-right die corner to the exploded floorplan plate, so the lifted logic overlay reads as standing off the die rather than floating; routed just outside the heatsink so it does not clip the fins.

parts.name: Exploded-view standoff (front-left)
parts.role: Thin riser tying the front-left die corner to the exploded floorplan plate, clear of the heatsink footprint.

parts.name: Exploded-view standoff (rear-right)
parts.role: Thin riser tying the rear-right die corner to the exploded floorplan plate, clear of the heatsink footprint.

parts.name: Exploded-view standoff (rear-left)
parts.role: Thin riser tying the rear-left die corner to the exploded floorplan plate, clear of the heatsink footprint.

parts.name: HBM stack (left)
parts.role: In-package high-bandwidth memory stack streaming polynomial coefficients into the NTT pipeline.

parts.name: HBM stack (right)
parts.role: In-package high-bandwidth memory stack buffering transformed coefficients back to the host.

parts.name: Clock oscillator
parts.role: Crystal oscillator providing the reference clock that paces the butterfly's 6-cycle pipeline and the multiplier's 4-cycle latency.

parts.name: Decoupling cap 0
parts.role: Bulk decoupling capacitor stabilizing the core supply near the die.

parts.name: Decoupling cap 1
parts.role: Bulk decoupling capacitor stabilizing the core supply near the die.

parts.name: Auxiliary power connector
parts.role: Auxiliary power header feeding the board's core-rail regulators.

parts.name: Datapath floorplan plate
parts.role: Exploded floorplan of the die's synthesized CFNTT-KRED butterfly region, lifted on four standoffs; grounds the logic blocks so the exploded overlay reads as one datapath instead of floating parts.

parts.name: Coefficient bank 0
parts.role: One of two conflict-free coefficient banks; holds even-parity addresses and streams the u operand into the butterfly, receives bf_lower back.

spec.notes: 2-bank parity mapping is untouched from the reference; two banks let each butterfly read/write both operands per cycle without conflict.

parts.name: Coefficient bank 1
parts.role: The odd-parity coefficient bank; streams the v operand into the butterfly's multiplier lane and receives bf_upper back.

parts.name: Address generators
parts.role: Per-bank address generators computing the butterfly stride/offset each stage so both banks stay conflict-free.

parts.name: Twiddle ROM (shared)
parts.role: Single shared 1023-word twiddle ROM storing W = 9^-1·w so that 9·v·W = v·w exactly in the NTT butterfly — no post-multiply correction needed; taller footprint signals its word depth vs the small registers.

spec.notes: Layout/size identical to reference tf_ROM; the 9^-1 pre-scaling is what makes the factor 9 from K-RED disappear architecturally.

parts.name: u input DFF
parts.role: Registers the u coefficient and delays it (shift_4 / u_q5) to align with the 4-cycle multiplier output before the modular add.

parts.name: v input DFF
parts.role: Registers the v coefficient and feeds it into the pre-multiplier operand mux (v_mux) that supplies the K-RED multiplier's A input.

parts.name: v-operand sel mux
parts.role: Pre-multiplier A-operand mux: sel=0 forwards v (NTT), sel=1 forwards (v−u) (INTT / Gentleman–Sande) into the K-RED multiplier's A input; driven by the control FSM.

spec.notes: One of the two '[mux sel] before modular_mul' points in compact_bf_v2; paired with ntt_intt_mux on the B operand.

parts.name: w twiddle delay chain
parts.role: Two-stage delay of the twiddle W read from ROM, aligning it to the multiplier's B input; longer in Z to show the w_q1→w_q2 pipeline depth.

spec.notes: w --DFF--> w_q1 --DFF--> w_q2 in compact_bf_v2; then modular_half feeds the sel mux.

parts.name: op21 gate (ROM path)
parts.role: modular_half on the twiddle path: op21(W) = (2·9)^-1·w, deriving the INTT twiddle from the SAME ROM word at zero multiplier cost.

spec.notes: One of the two op21 gates that fix reference issue #7; fuses the per-stage INTT halving into the twiddle derivation.

parts.name: NTT/INTT sel mux
parts.role: Pre-multiplier B-operand mux: sel=0 forwards W (NTT), sel=1 forwards op21(W) (INTT); driven by the control FSM in lockstep with v_mux.

fsm.sel=0: NTT: (bf_lower, bf_upper) = (u + v*w, u - v*w), latency 6

parts.name: K-RED multiplier (stage 1)
parts.role: The ONLY hardware multiplier in the butterfly: a 14×14→28-bit product z = A·B (the reference Barrett unit spent three multipliers); also re-driven by the PWM return bus for the double-pass mode.

spec.notes: modular_mul_kred.v stage 1; drops DSP usage per butterfly from 3 to 1 (-67%).

parts.name: K-RED fold 1 (stage 2)
parts.role: First shift-add fold reducing the 28-bit product to 17 bits: d = 3·z[11:0] + 6q − z[27:12], equal to 3z mod q.

spec.notes: Replaces a constant multiplier with shifts+adds using 3*2^12 == -1 (mod q), q = 12289 = 3*2^12 + 1.

parts.name: K-RED fold 2 (stage 3)
parts.role: Second shift-add fold reducing 17 bits to 15: e = 3·d[11:0] + q − d[16:12], equal to 9z mod q.

parts.name: Conditional subtract (stage 4)
parts.role: Single conditional subtraction r = (e ≥ q) ? e − q : e, yielding the final 9·A·B mod q with r < q; result also tapped by the PWM return bus for a second pass.

ops: r = e >= q ? e - q : e
spec.notes: Output = 9*A*B mod q; the twiddle's 9^-1 pre-scaling cancels the factor 9 downstream.

parts.name: modular_add
parts.role: Combines the delayed u with the multiplier output: (u + v·w) and (u − v·w) form bf_lower/bf_upper, written back to the two banks.

parts.name: op21 gate (add path)
parts.role: modular_half on the INTT add path: op21(u+v) = (u+v)/2 mod q; with the ROM-path op21 this restores the per-stage halving the reference omitted.

spec.notes: Together with mod_half_a fixes reference issue #7 — the released radix-2 INTT is otherwise scaled by 2^10.

parts.name: INTT add-path sel mux
parts.role: Add-path output mux: sel=0 forwards (u + v·w) (NTT), sel=1 forwards op21(u+v) from mod_half_b (INTT halving) onto the bank-0 writeback; driven by the control FSM.

spec.notes: The '[mux sel] on the u_q5/add path' of compact_bf_v2; selects the halved sum only during INTT.

parts.name: PWM double-pass return bus
parts.role: Copper return spine for the PWM double-pass mode: routes the K-RED result from kred_csub back into v_mux so the single K-RED unit runs a second pass (stored 81^-1 = 11227) for pointwise multiplication.

spec.notes: Depicts the FSM's double-pass PWM reuse of modular_mul_kred rather than a second multiplier.

parts.name: Control FSM
parts.role: Sequencer driving the 2-bank addressing, the twiddle ROM address (r-counter − 1), the v/B operand muxes and the add-path sel line across the 6-cycle butterfly pipeline.

spec.notes: Butterfly latency 6, multiplier latency 4; also drives the PWM double-pass mode (stored 81^-1 = 11227) reusing the same K-RED unit.

parts.name: Datapath bus
parts.role: Shared coefficient/operand spine threading the input DFFs, operand muxes, K-RED pipeline, modular add and control FSM along the exploded floorplan.
